command:

command:
set -eu
if ! id appworker >/dev/null 2>&1; then useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash appworker; fi
umask 022
printf '%s\n' 'appworker - nofile 8192' 'appworker - nproc 256' > /etc/security/limits.d/60-appworker.conf
chown root:root /etc/security/limits.d/60-appworker.conf
chmod 0644 /etc/security/limits.d/60-appworker.conf
printf 'account: '; getent passwd appworker
printf 'limits_config:\n'; cat /etc/security/limits.d/60-appworker.conf
